expectations.text: Names the horizons from Ground/runway through Horizon 5 (purpose/principles)
expectations.evidence: Headings name all six: 'Horizon 5 (50,000 ft): Purpose and Principles', 'Horizon 4 (40,000 ft): Vision', 'Horizon 3 (30,000 ft): 1-2 Year Goals', 'Horizon 2 (20,000 ft): Areas of Focus and Responsibility', 'Horizon 1 (10,000 ft): Current Projects', 'Ground (Runway): Next Actions and Calendar'. Order and content match SKILL.md (altitude labels are Allen's older metaphor; 'Responsibility' vs 'accountabilities' is a minor wording difference).

expectations.text: Places the 2-year goal at the right horizon (vision, ~3-5 years, or goals 1-2 years)
expectations.evidence: Horizon 3: 'This is where your 2-year deadline lives', turned into a measurable 'Quit Trigger'; Horizon 4 framed as 3-5 years beyond it. Correct placement.

expectations.text: Gives concrete content at each horizon
expectations.evidence: Concrete content at every level: H5 draft purpose and four principles; H4 present-tense vision with business/lifestyle/financial/personal elements; H3 quit-trigger conditions and a milestone table by month; H2 day-job, business and life areas; H1 ten projects plus Someday/Maybe; Ground next actions by context and calendar items.

Ground section: 'Each active project gets one concrete next action, sorted by context' with each action tagged to its project (e.g. 'Draft a list of 20 people who match my target customer (Validate idea)'); plus the 'why test' chain from 'Text Sarah...' (Runway) up to Purpose.

'Review rhythm' table: Next Actions daily, Projects weekly (Weekly Review), Areas weekly-monthly, Goals monthly+quarterly, Vision quarterly, Purpose yearly; calendar also schedules quarterly reviews and month-12/18 checkpoints.
